READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q', 'd')
READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q', 'd', 'o')
READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Qa', 'qa', 'da', 'oa')

READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, 'd', 'o')
READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, NULL, 'o')
READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
READ	SELECT mask(NULL)

READ	SELECT mask(NULL, NULL, NULL, 'd', 'o')

READ	SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
READ	SELECT mask(c1) from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)

READ	SELECT mask(c1, NULL, NULL, 'd', 'o') from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
READ	SELECT mask(c1, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'o') from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)

READ	SELECT mask(c1, NULL, 'q', 'd', 'o') from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
READ	SELECT mask(c1, 'Q', NULL, 'd', 'o') from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
READ	SELECT mask(c1, 'Q', 'q', NULL, 'o') from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
READ	SELECT mask(c1, 'Q', 'q', 'd', NULL) from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
READ	SELECT mask(NULL, 'Q', 'q', 'd', NULL) from values ('AbCD123-@$#') as tab(c1)
